_comment: This age. Its folder name is its key. 'order': ages come in this order. 'requires': innovations (of earlier ages) that must all be discovered to enter it. 'government_on_arrival': on entering, the government becomes the first of these (keys in this age's governments/ folder) whose own 'requires' are researched, else the last. 'innovation_cost_multiplier': every cost in this age's innovations.json is multiplied by it (1: the cost in the file is the cost in the game). 'terms': what this age calls things on screen and in the chronicle (a government file may override them with its own 'terms'). 'store_panel': what the top bar shows of the shared store, left to right; a group takes 'items' (item keys) and/or 'kinds' (every item of that kind); 'empty_warning': red when there are none. A later age inherits the panel and terms of the age before unless it sets its own.
name: Tribal Age
description: Small kin groups that move with the seasons. Leadership is by influence and agreement.
_start_comment: The first age also says what a new game starts with: 'starting_inventory' is what everyone carries (players.json 'inventory' adds to it per person) and 'starting_store' what the shared store holds (empty: everything must be gathered).
